title: Palladium
body:
Description


Palladium ore can spawn on Ferwater island with chance 1/650 and is commonly found in the rock nodes of Beigeslate, Limestone, Blueslate, Chalkyslate, Terracotta, Sandslate, and Blackstone.

Raw Palladium can be easily mistaken for Gold if not given a second glance. To see the difference, pay close attention to the brightness of the ore before mining, as Palladium is slightly darker than Gold. Otherwise, its appearance is much like Caramel - a golden brown color.

Like any other materials in the game, you can use refined and forged Palladium to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • While Pyrite is what's known as "Fool's Gold" in real life, Gold and Palladium share the same node model and a very similar color. This makes Gold more likely to be confused with Palladium rather than with Pyrite, whose model resembles more of a square.
  • Palladium appears to be a combined Gold and Lithium, but can also be considered a mix of Cobalt and Gold.

New information

  • Palladium can now be found by breaking vases in Desert Temple, sublocation of Ferwater
  • The refined variant of Palladium is now used in quests for getting Dune Devourer Helmet & Chestplate
